training_goal: replay historical rare-disease discovery to medicine-creation logic, store hit logic, then reuse patterns for new rare diseases

cases.summary: seed training case for replaying how rare-disease interpretation, first medicine logic, later improvement logic, and setbacks are stored

discovery.doctor_researcher_view: neurodevelopmental disorder with severe functional regression; early thinking focused on symptom clusters before deeper mechanism clarity
discovery.suspected_mechanism: broad neuronal signaling and plasticity disruption with incomplete target certainty
discovery.dominant_symptom_model: regression, cognition, movement, and communication impairment
unknowns: root upstream mechanism incompletely specified at early timepoint
unclear whether symptom model or mechanism model should dominate first intervention logic

first_medicine.why_created: created to capture the strongest tractable symptom-mechanism bridge available at the time

target_logic.rationale: attempt to improve neuronal signaling function

first_medicine.mechanism_summary: choose tractable signaling-support path before full disease mechanism is known
limitations: did not fully close disease deviation

later_medicines.why_created: created after observing limits of partial symptomatic logic

target_logic.rationale: close more of the remaining neuroplasticity gap

later_medicines.mechanism_summary: move from partial support to stronger gap-closing target logic
later_medicines.expected_benefit: higher coverage and stronger disease-mechanism fit
later_medicines.why_better_than_previous: more powerful because it closes deviation left by the first approach

failures.label: over-symptom framing
failures.reason: too much weight on surface symptoms and too little on mechanism
failures.lesson: store symptom model and mechanism model separately during replay

failures.label: partial target closure
failures.reason: first design did not close remaining deviation targets
failures.lesson: track uncovered gap explicitly after first medicine selection

patterns.pattern_summary: rare neurodevelopmental case often starts with partial tractable target, then moves to gap-fill logic
patterns.first_medicine_logic: choose tractable primary path even when full upstream certainty is absent
patterns.improvement_logic: later medicine improves by closing explicit residual deviation
patterns.failure_logic: first pass often fails by underweighting upstream mechanism and uncovered gap
patterns.reusable_rule: store primary-first then deviation-fill rule and reuse for similar new rare diseases

discovery.doctor_researcher_view: thought process centered on developmental/cognitive dysfunction with incomplete molecular clarity

later_medicines.why_created: created to address residual deviation left by narrower first medicine

failures.reason: first medicine focused on one tractable branch only
failures.lesson: store preserved hit logic separately from missing-gap logic

patterns.pattern_summary: effective next medicine often preserves what worked and extends into the remaining gap
patterns.improvement_logic: keep winning logic and extend into missing targets
